svg.title: Forgetting run: Graphite sketch being erased
svg.desc: Forgetting run (2D): a side-on run drawn in graphite on paper. On the left a wall of blank paper is erasing the world, leaving eraser crumbs where the ground was; the runner leaps onto the stretch of path they are holding Recall on, drawn solid and dark. Ahead the path is only a faint outline until it is remembered, a lit touchstone lantern refills Focus, and the outpost gates at the right edge are still only half inked in.
svg.text: hold RECALL: the next 6 m stay drawn for 3 s
